instruction: Add the video file to VLC's playlist as a second item by opening the file again through the Media menu.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding the same video file to VLC's playlist a second time (Media > Open File or right-click > Enqueue). The evaluator queries VLC's HTTP interface to check if the playlist has at least 2 items.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly queries VLC's HTTP interface to extract playlist count using appropriate XML parsing of /requests/playlist.xml endpoint
Metric correctly compares playlist count against minimum required items (>= 2) with proper logic
Data flow is semantically correct: getter returns integer count, metric receives it and performs appropriate comparison
Instruction requirement (add video as second item) is fully covered by checking playlist has at least 2 items
Expected value (min_items: 2) is semantically correct for this verification task
Metric correctly handles expected parameter as rules dictionary (expected.get('min_items', 2)) which matches framework behavior for type='rule'
State accessibility is appropriate - VLC HTTP interface remains accessible while VLC is running, no postconfig needed
Edge cases handled reasonably - getter returns 0 on HTTP failure, metric handles this correctly
